name: Image2Img
tagline: image2img.net is a free image to image AI tool that turns any uploaded photo into a new image in seconds, with no sign-up and no watermark.
description: Image2Img is a free online image-to-image AI tool. Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo (up to 20 MB), pick a ready-made look such as anime, 90s film, doodle, paper collage, hairstyle preview, old-photo restore or studio headshot, or describe the change in plain words. The tool keeps the person, pose and composition while changing only what you ask for, and you can keep editing the result across versions. Everyone gets 1 free image a day with or without an account, no sign-up and no watermark; logging in only saves work. Results are deleted after 2 days (or 30 days if saved). Contact: support@image2img.net.
